title: Understanding Data Influence in Transportation Networks: A Physics-Constrained Influence-Function Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.07526v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how individual training observations influence model predictions is important for developing reliable and interpretable data-driven transportation systems. Existing influence-function methods, however, are primarily formulated for unconstrained learning and do not explicitly account for physical constraints that couple different components of a transportation network. Under such constraints, perturbing a training observation can affect model parameters and predictions only through physically feasible directions, potentially changing how its influence propagates across the network. This paper develops a hard physics-informed influence-function framework for constrained learning, in which training-data influence is characterized within the physically feasible space defined by network constraints. The analytical results reveal how physical constraints alter the magnitude, direction, and spatial distribution of training-sample

translated_title: 理解交通网络中的数据影响：一个物理约束的影响函数框架
translated_abstract: 理解单个训练观测样本如何影响模型预测，对于构建可靠且可解释的数据驱动交通系统至关重要。然而，现有影响函数方法主要是针对无约束学习设计的，并未显式考虑将交通网络各组件耦合在一起的物理约束。在此类约束下，对训练观测样本的扰动只能通过物理可行的方向影响模型参数和预测，这可能改变其影响在网络中的传播方式。本文针对约束学习提出了一种硬物理信息影响函数框架，在该框架中，训练数据的影响是在由网络约束所定义的物理可行空间内进行刻画的。解析结果揭示了物理约束如何改变训练样本影响的幅度、方向和空间分布。
tldr: 本文提出面向约束学习的硬物理约束影响函数框架，在交通网络物理可行空间内刻画训练数据对模型的影响，揭示了物理约束如何改变影响的幅度、方向与空间传播。
